definition_zh: 诈取；骗取；赖账；挫败；使落空；逃避（债务等）
definition_en: to cheat someone out of money or goods; to thwart or evade payment
core_image: 牌桌后面换牌的手：账单到手，钱却飞了
scene: 账单寄了三回，那家公司仍拖着不付。The contractor bilked dozens of homeowners.
sceneCN: 这里 bilk 是「诈取、骗取」（第 1 个义项：用欺骗手段夺走钱财）；句意是承包商骗了数十位房主。

derivatives.zh: 过去分词转形容词，义为「被骗的；落空的」
动词加施动者后缀 -er 构成，义为「骗子；赖账者」
近义词，义为「诈骗」，多指成规模的骗局

senses.title: To cheat out of money
senses.definition: to obtain money or property from someone by deceit
senses.definitionCN: 以欺骗手段取得他人钱财或财物
senses.example: The contractor bilked dozens of homeowners.
senses.exampleCN: 承包商骗了数十位房主。
senses.why: The word arose at the card table, where cheating emptied pockets.
senses.whyCN: 该词起于牌桌，出千者掏空他人钱袋。

senses.title: To evade paying a debt
senses.definition: to avoid paying a bill or debt
senses.example: The firm bilked suppliers for two years.
senses.exampleCN: 那家公司赖了供货商两年的账。
senses.why: Refusing to pay is cheating the creditor of what is owed.
senses.whyCN: 拒付即是骗走债主应得之款。

senses.title: To thwart or frustrate
senses.definition: to defeat a plan, hope, or expectation
senses.definitionCN: 使计划、希望或期待落空
senses.example: Bad weather bilked the climbers' summit bid.
senses.exampleCN: 恶劣天气让登山者的登顶计划落空。
senses.why: Taking away the expected reward is cheating expectation itself.
senses.whyCN: 夺走期待的回报，便是欺骗了期待本身。

senses.title: To escape or slip away from
senses.definition: to get away from or elude, as one escapes a duty
senses.definitionCN: 逃避、溜脱，如躲避义务或追索
senses.example: He bilked the bailiffs by moving at midnight.
senses.exampleCN: 他半夜搬家躲过了法警。
senses.why: The debtor's escape is a card-sharp's trick turned into motion.
senses.whyCN: 赖债者的脱身，是牌桌骗术化为脚步。

senses.title: To cheat at cards (original sense)
senses.definition: to spoil another's scoring card or cheat at cribbage
senses.definitionCN: 毁坏他人记分牌或在克里比奇纸牌中作弊
senses.example: The old sense meant bilking the score at cards.
senses.exampleCN: 古义指在牌局中做手脚毁人记分。
senses.why: The first recorded use spoils an opponent's cribbage score.
senses.whyCN: 最早的书证正是弄脏对手的纸牌记分。

senses.title: To defraud investors or institutions
senses.definition: to run a fraud against many victims or large organizations
senses.definitionCN: 对众多受害者或大型机构实施诈骗
senses.example: The scheme bilked pension funds of millions.
senses.exampleCN: 该骗局骗走了养老基金数百万。
senses.why: Modern fraud scales the card-table trick upward.
senses.whyCN: 现代骗局把牌桌把戏放大了规模。

senses.title: To deny someone their due
senses.definition: to keep from someone something owed or expected
senses.definitionCN: 使某人得不到应得或应期之物
senses.example: Injury bilked her of an Olympic place.
senses.exampleCN: 伤病让她与奥运席位失之交臂。
senses.why: Fate, too, can refuse to pay what was promised.
senses.whyCN: 命运同样会赖掉它许过的账。

senses.title: To cheat justice or rules
senses.definition: to evade taxes, duties, or penalties dishonestly
senses.definitionCN: 以不正当手段逃税、逃费或逃避处罚
senses.example: They bilked the customs for years with false invoices.
senses.exampleCN: 他们用假发票逃了海关多年。
senses.why: Rules, like creditors, can be cheated of their due.
senses.whyCN: 规则如债主，同样可被赖掉应得之物。

intro.en: Bilk arose in 17th-century English among card-players, of uncertain deeper origin.
intro.cn: bilk 起于 17 世纪英语牌桌用语，更早来源不确定。

items.en: first recorded about 1650 as a verb meaning to cheat at cribbage, spoiling the score.
items.cn: 约 1650 年首见，为动词，指在克里比奇纸牌中毁记分作弊。

items.en: perhaps linked to dialect balk, to thwart; connection uncertain.
items.cn: 或与方言 balk「阻碍」相关；关联不确定。

items.en: the meaning spread from card-cheating to cheating of any kind.
items.cn: 词义从牌桌作弊扩展为一切欺诈。

items.en: thieves' slang used bilk for a cheat and for cheating.
items.cn: 18 世纪盗贼黑话以 bilk 称骗子与行骗。

items.en: now chiefly journalistic: to defraud, evade payment, or thwart.
items.cn: 如今多用于新闻语体：诈骗、赖账或使落空。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers near spellings; the near-meaning group gathers cheating words.
note.cn: 形近组汇集近形拼写；近义组汇集欺诈类词。

entries.definition: to refuse to proceed; to thwart
entries.definitionCN: 犹豫不前；阻碍——拼写相近，或有关联但不确定

entries.definition: the lowest part of a hull; nonsense
entries.definitionCN: 船底污水；胡说——拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: to cheat by a fraudulent scheme
to deprive by deceit, in legal register

normalIntro.en: Bilk began as card-table slang for cheating.
normalIntro.cn: bilk 起初是牌桌黑话，指作弊行骗。

normal.en: The common pattern is bilk someone out of money.
normal.cn: 常用句式是 bilk someone out of money。

normal.en: It also means to evade payment.
Figuratively it means to thwart hopes.
The earliest sense was cheating at cards.
Balk looks similar but means to hesitate.
normal.cn: balk 拼写相近但意为犹豫不前。

abstract.en: See the ace sliding out of a sleeve.
Feel the invoice go unanswered, month after month.
abstract.cn: 感受账单月月石沉大海。

abstract.en: Picture the promised prize vanishing at the last step.
abstract.cn: 想象到手的奖赏在最后一步蒸发。

examples.en: The contractor bilked dozens of homeowners.
examples.cn: 承包商骗了数十位房主。

examples.en: The scheme bilked pension funds of millions.
examples.cn: 该骗局骗走了养老基金数百万。

examples.en: Bad weather bilked the climbers' summit bid.
examples.cn: 恶劣天气让登山者的登顶计划落空。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「避了口」——债主上门，他从后门避了口子溜走，赖账跑路。

root: 17 世纪中叶英语牌桌黑话，首见证于约 1650 年，指毁坏纸牌记分作弊；更早来源不确定，或与方言 balk「阻碍」有关（存疑）；词义扩展为一切诈骗、赖账与挫败，今多用于新闻语体。

sensesIntro.en: From spoiling a card score, bilk grew into fraud, debt-dodging, and dashed hopes.
sensesIntro.cn: 从毁牌记分出发，bilk 长出诈骗、躲债与希望落空诸义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand behind the back slipping the stake away
core.cn: 核心意象：手在背后把赌注悄悄抽走

intro.en: Bilk is a bare English slang verb of uncertain origin.
intro.cn: bilk 是来源不明的英语光杆俚语动词。

latinIntro.en: No Latin kin; bilk is native English slang.
latinIntro.cn: 无拉丁同族；bilk 属英语本土俚语。

items.meaningCN: 阻碍；拒绝（或有关联，存疑）
船底舱；胡言（异源近形词）
